messages.adminIntro: Choose a Boolean field for an entity. When that field is checked on a record, the record stays visible but becomes read-only for users without permission to edit locked records. You can also set this in Entity Manager > Fields.
messages.noLockFields: No lock fields yet. Add one below.
messages.noEligibleFields: No entity has an available Boolean field. Create a Boolean field in Entity Manager first.
messages.whoCanEdit: Administrators can always edit locked records. Other users need “Edit Locked Records Permission” set to “yes” in one of their roles. Portal users get it from portal roles.
messages.confirmTurnOff: Turn off the lock for the “{field}” field of {entity}? Records will be editable again according to the usual access rights.
messages.lockedCannotEdit: This record is locked ({fields}). Only users with permission to edit locked records can change it.
messages.lockedCanEdit: This record is locked ({fields}). You can edit it because you have permission to edit locked records.
messages.editBlocked: This record is locked. You can view it, but you can’t save changes.
messages.streamLocked: This record is locked. You can’t post to its stream.
messages.streamLockedNotice: This record is locked. Its stream is closed for new posts.
messages.listIconHelp: Icon in lists: shows a lock next to locked records in list views and record selection popups.
messages.lockStreamHelp: Lock stream: users without permission to edit locked records can’t post to the stream of a locked record, or edit or remove posts there.
messages.entityOptionsNote: Both settings apply to the whole entity.
